Medications include Levothyroxine (50mcg), Losartn HCTZ (100-12.5mg), Celecoxib (200mg twice daily), and omeprazole. No allergies. Drinks alcohol daily (reducing), quit tobacco 1995. Utilizes functional medicine, homeopathy, and TCM.
